# Harbert Onyedeke — Official Professional Profile

Primary source: https://harbert-onyedeke-ai-portfolio.vercel.app/
Canonical name: Onyedeke Harbert Izuchukwu
Also known as: Harbert Onyedeke; Facilitator Harbert; AI Chief Priest
Location: Oshodi, Lagos State, Nigeria

## Professional identity
Nigerian AI Generalist, applied-AI product builder, generative AI educator and digital skills facilitator. Focus areas include practical AI education, applied AI products, prompt design, education technology, responsible AI adoption and community capacity development.

## Organisation
Founder of Embassey Group. Its business activities include Embassey Digital and Tech Academy, Embassey Digital & Tech Services, Embassey Media & Vibes Studio, and Embassey Renewable Energy & Solar Systems.
